steps.code:
# Let's get the liked song IDs and then keep going to next song until we hit a liked one.
liked_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token)}
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

# Loop to go to next song until current song is liked
for _ in range(20):  # safety limit
    result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", result)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Current song:", current)
    if current['song_id'] in liked_song_ids:
        print("Found liked song:", current['title'])
        break
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue")
